action.objective: Play Bb4+, the sole commit-ready move, preserving the exact depth-4 score and king activity while keeping the bishop on an active diagonal.
action.rationale: Bb4+ is the only commit_ready_move: single-candidate verification at depth 4 returned exact 905 with complete safety probe (no mating reply, no tactical refutation). Broad depth-3 had it top at 942 (exact) and Bc3 at 884 exact verified deeper. Bb4+ checks the king, attacks e7 and d6/c5/a5, and Black's forced reply keeps our bishop active. No refutation and no replan required.
